title: ranunculus pullaster
intro: Ranunculus pullaster, commonly known as lesser celandine, is a perennial plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). The plant's health benefits include its ability to treat various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. Ranunculus pullaster's therapeutic actions include its use as an antispasmodic, antiseptic, and antitumor agent. The plant contains bioactive constituents like ranunculin, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, along with other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
